iure esse, cui tanquam summo magistratui in
curandis matrimonijs pareant. Quarto,non

page.notes: Printed "Rebeccæ" is doubtful in its last letter; it may be "Rebeccæ" or "Rebeccę". Long s has been rendered as s throughout. The "ct" ligature in "reluctandum" and "&" are as printed. The dot marks beside "tentiae" (left) and "vel" (right) are not letters and are not transcribed.
